prerequisites: Students should be in the final phase of their studies.

learning_outcomes.text: The student has demonstrated that they can successfully apply course content from previous lectures using the following tools and methods: Project management
Group work and conflict management (especially for project scopes with at least two students)

syllabus_topics: Project tasks can be taken from all teaching areas of previous semesters in the Mechanical Engineering degree program.
Accompanying seminar on scientific working methods
assessment_rules: Successful completion of the project work is required for the awarding of credit points. Grading is weighted according to ECTS credit points.
